name: Bodyweight squat
steps: Feet shoulder-width apart, chest up.
Sit your hips back and down until thighs are near parallel, then stand up.

name: Wall sit
steps: Back flat on a wall, slide down until knees are at 90 degrees.
Hold without leaning on your hands.

name: Jump squat
steps: Squat down, then jump up explosively.
Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next rep.

name: Split squat
steps: Step one foot forward, back knee under your hip.
Lower straight down and push through the front heel.

name: Walking lunge
steps: Step forward and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Push off the front foot into the next step.

name: Glute bridge
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Push your hips up, squeeze your glutes, lower slowly.

name: Push-up (or knee push-up)
steps: Hands under shoulders, body in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the floor and press back up. Drop to your knees if needed.

name: Incline push-up (hands on a table)
steps: Hands on a sturdy table or sofa edge.
Lower your chest to the edge and press up.

name: Pike push-up
steps: Hips high in an upside-down V.
Bend your elbows to lower your head toward the floor, then press up.

name: Chair dips
steps: Hands on a sturdy chair behind you, legs forward.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees and press up.

name: Superman hold
steps: Lie face down, arms forward.
Lift arms, chest and legs a few centimetres and hold.

name: Prone Y-T-W raise
steps: Lie face down.
Raise your arms into a Y, then a T, then a W shape, squeezing your shoulder blades.

name: Inverted row under a sturdy table
steps: Lie under a strong table and grip the edge.
Pull your chest to the table keeping your body straight.

name: Plank
steps: Forearms on the floor, body in a straight line.
Squeeze your stomach and glutes and hold.

name: Side plank
steps: Lie on your side on one forearm.
Lift your hips so your body is a straight line and hold.

name: Dead bug
steps: Lie on your back, arms up, knees over hips.
Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly while your back stays flat.

name: Mountain climbers
steps: Start in a high plank.
Drive your knees to your chest one after the other, quickly.

name: Jumping jacks
steps: Jump your feet wide while raising your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start and keep a steady rhythm.

name: High knees
steps: Run on the spot lifting your knees to hip height.
Pump your arms.

name: Burpees
steps: Squat, place your hands down and jump your feet back to a plank.
Do a push-up, jump your feet in and jump up.

name: Brisk walk
steps: Walk fast enough that you can talk but not sing.
Swing your arms and keep your head up.

name: Jog
steps: Run at a pace where you can still speak short sentences.
Land softly and keep your shoulders relaxed.

name: Stair climbing
steps: Climb stairs at a steady pace.
Walk down slowly to recover.

name: Goblet squat
steps: Hold one dumbbell at your chest.
Squat down keeping your chest tall, then stand.

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
steps: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings, then stand.

name: One-arm dumbbell row
steps: Hand and knee on a bench or chair, back flat.
Pull the dumbbell to your hip and lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
steps: Dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press overhead without arching your back, then lower.

name: Dumbbell bench press
steps: Lie on a bench with dumbbells over your chest.
Lower to chest level and press up.

name: Dumbbell floor press
steps: Lie on the floor with dumbbells over your chest.
Lower until your elbows touch the floor, then press up.

name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
steps: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Step back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees, then stand.

name: Dumbbell curl
steps: Elbows by your sides.
Curl the dumbbells to your shoulders and lower slowly.

name: Resistance-band row
steps: Anchor the band at chest height.
Pull your hands to your ribs and squeeze your shoulder blades.

name: Band pull-apart
steps: Hold the band in front of you with straight arms.
Pull it apart to your chest level and return slowly.

name: Band chest press
steps: Anchor the band behind you.
Press your hands forward until your arms are straight.

name: Band squat
steps: Stand on the band, hold the ends at your shoulders.
Squat down and stand up against the resistance.

name: Pull-up
steps: Hang from the bar with hands just wider than shoulders.
Pull your chin over the bar and lower under control.

name: Hanging knee raise
steps: Hang from the bar.
Raise your knees toward your chest without swinging.

name: Jump rope
steps: Turn the rope with your wrists.
Jump just high enough to clear it and land softly.

name: Barbell back squat
steps: Bar on your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat to parallel keeping your chest up, then drive up.

name: Deadlift
steps: Bar over mid-foot, flat back.
Push the floor away and stand tall, then lower with control.

name: Barbell bench press
steps: Lie on the bench, grip just wider than shoulders.
Lower the bar to your chest and press up. Use a spotter for heavy sets.

name: Lat pulldown
steps: Grip the bar wide and sit tall.
Pull it to your upper chest and return slowly.

name: Seated cable row
steps: Sit tall with a flat back.
Pull the handle to your stomach and squeeze your shoulder blades.

name: Leg press
steps: Feet shoulder-width on the plate.
Lower until your knees are about 90 degrees and press without locking out.

name: Machine chest press
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height.
Press forward and return slowly.

name: Leg curl machine
steps: Adjust the pad above your heels.
Curl your heels toward your hips and lower slowly.

name: Cable triceps pushdown
steps: Elbows pinned to your sides.
Press the handle down until your arms are straight.

name: Cable face pull
steps: Rope at face height.
Pull toward your face with elbows high and squeeze.

name: Treadmill (walk or jog)
steps: Pick a speed you can hold while talking in short sentences.
Add a little incline to make it harder.

name: Stationary bike
steps: Adjust the seat to hip height.
Keep a steady cadence at a moderate effort.

name: Rowing machine
steps: Push with your legs first, then lean back and pull.
Return in the reverse order.

name: Elliptical
steps: Stand tall and hold the handles lightly.
Keep a smooth, steady rhythm.
